content.short: Renzo is a liquid restaking protocol on EigenLayer that abstracts restaking complexities via the ezETH token.
content.description:
Renzo is a premier liquid restaking protocol built natively on EigenLayer, designed to simplify and maximize rewards for Ethereum participants. By allowing users to deposit ETH or Liquid Staking Tokens (LSTs), the protocol issues ezETH, a highly composable Liquid Restaked Token (LRT). This allows participants to simultaneously earn Ethereum staking rewards and additional yields from Actively Validated Services (AVS) on the EigenLayer network, effectively amplifying their capital efficiency.

Operating across major networks including Ethereum, Arbitrum, and Linea, Renzo serves as a vital strategy manager for the restaking economy. The platform focuses on professional-grade risk management and transparent on-chain execution, providing a seamless user experience that abstracts the technical hurdles of restaking. Through its commitment to innovation and deep integration with the DeFi ecosystem, Renzo is empowering users to build and manage sophisticated decentralized portfolios while maintaining total sovereignty over their digital capital.
content.meta: Renzo provides liquid restaking through ezETH, enabling users to earn multiple yield layers while maintaining liquidity.
